scope: Actual mutex adapters, offset-list allocation/walk/stores, watchdog registration/flags/port calls and pinned FreeRTOS current-task getter with actual source memory/string functions
limitations: Heap allocation, CMSIS mutex operations and final watchdog sample callbacks are intercepted.
Manager initialization, actual time/sample backend, full kernel layout, scheduler concurrency and physical watchdog behavior remain open.
Native register stores only seven name bytes after uint8 strlen truncation and rejects exact duplicate names; these quirks are preserved.
Original instruction identity and whole-image source completeness remain open.
